Game Overview

In Space Scale, the core idea is straightforward: experience a rhythm-infused cosmic adventure with Space Scale. Guide Giba through thrilling 2D platforming challenges, using rhythmic cues to time precise jumps. Navigate vivid space landscapes, conserving oxygen as you race against time to reach your spaceship. Immerse in seamless, melody-driven gameplay that's both strategic and exhilarating.
